text_block_list.text:
After our outing, as I returned to the academy
alongside Matikanefukukitaru—
I tripped over something and fell...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!?
Are you okay, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wait, waaaaaah!
Y-Your shoelace snapped!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
My geta strap snapped?!
An absolute firesale of bad luck is heading our way!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...Wait!?
Didn't something like this happen before!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, more importantly, this is a crisis!
We must ward off Trainer-san's bad luck immediately!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's try a good-luck charm
I recently found on the internet!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's a good luck charm where we hold hands—
the "Hand-Holding" ritual!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Come now, take my hand!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
There's no time to hesitate!!
Your Great Unlucky Period is about to arrive!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Come on, hurry!
choice_data_list: I'll just play it off with a high-five

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now then, time to boost my luck!
Tohhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
See, you can feel that warm lucky power
flowing right into you, can't you~?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Howawa... Somehow, the warmth feels much stronger
than when I do this with others.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: "Could it be that you, Trainer, are overflowing with good luck power?!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh,
I just noticed something great~!

For a while after that, on days with bad fortune,
Matikanefukukitaru would try to hold hands.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Huh? Y-Yay?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah, somehow that made me
feel so cheerful!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
High fives hold such hidden power!?
Could this even surpass 'holding hands'......!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's do a bunch of them!
High five! Yay!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! This is so fun~!
Yeah, yeaah!

After that, we spent dozens of minutes high-fiving by the main gate,
and strangely enough, headed home in high spirits.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Are you really sure!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah, knowing my kind Trainer...
could you possibly be worried about me?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Could you be worried that
my terrible year of bad luck might rub off on you... Heh!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"You don't need to be so considerate!
A Trainer and Umamusume share a common destiny, after all!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: However, I do understand your kindness, Trainer. I'll pick a different good luck charm this time!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Nunununu~ Misfortune clinging to Trainer,
begone~ begone right now~!

Afterward, with her insisting, "It'd be terrible if anything
happened to you, Trainer!", I headed home
blessed with a whole barrage of good luck charms.
